content: AUTOSAR Shall provide Rules for Composition of Profiles for Data Exchange Points Type: valid Description: The Standardization template shall define rules for composing multiple profiles. Rationale: Modularization of profiles, combining profiles of multiple consuming tools. e.g.: it is acceptable if one tool requires some data while another considers this data as don't care. e.g.: a conflict occurs if one tool requires some data while another tool excludes it.
